adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` filters out emails already present in `booking.attendees` and blacklisted emails. If all submitted guests are already attendees, `uniqueGuests.length === 0` and the handler throws `TRPCError({ code: "BAD_REQUEST", message: "emails_must_be_unique_valid" })`, even though the submitted emails may be valid/unique but simply already added. This is a real, diff-grounded issue, but it’s primarily an incorrect/misleading error message rather than broken functionality.
